value.rationale: The named 2024 thermodynamic Mpemba model was previously illustrated by a crossing and asymptotic mode arguments. The new theorem excludes all reentrant free-energy orderings for every coherent Bloch state, gives necessary and sufficient coherence boundary, an exact strict monotonic normalized observable, and a sharp long-time coefficient. The physical question of whether the faster ordering can later reverse is nonroutine and naturally motivated by multiple-crossing Mpemba literature; this is a universal structural classification, not a numerical example.
